findings: Changing the idempotency-key format causes retries of an existing order attempt after deployment to use a new key, potentially bypassing provider-side idempotency and creating a duplicate checkout/payment. No compatibility or migration handling is shown.
evidence: The only behavioral change replaces `${orderId}:${attemptNumber}` with `${orderId}|${attemptNumber}`.
checked: Reviewed the supplied diff in src/routes/checkout.ts.
Treated malformed co-change-partner context as unavailable evidence.
gaps: No evidence that previously generated keys are not persisted, retried, parsed, or used by payment/webhook systems.
No evidence that orderId cannot contain `|` or that all consumers accept the new key format.
